0:
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: pvc-viewer
  labels:
    app: pvc-viewer
spec:
  containers:
  - name: viewer
    image: filebrowser/filebrowser:v2.63.14
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    args:
    - --noauth
    - --root=/mnt/
    - --port=8080
    - --address=0.0.0.0
    volumeMounts:
    - mountPath: /mnt/
      name: volume
    readOnly: false
  restartPolicy: Never
  volumes:
  - name: volume
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: "{pvc}"
